## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T15:10Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** disabled controls give no reason (accessibility). The read-only state itself is right.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. Apply objectui#12303's read-only-reason treatment to the Validations editor.

Claim: PM loop round 7 (`priority:p3`; triage grade `6218493223`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12691-validations-readonly-reason`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12691` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the Studio Data pillar's Validations editor on a read-only package.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` (`ObjectValidationsPanel`, which takes `disabled` from its mount): on a read-only package the editor states the existing reason (`engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint`, "Read-only package — switch to or create a writable package to edit.") so hover and keyboard reach it, by the treatment objectui#12303 gave the Field-properties inspector and Publish / Enabled already wear (a tooltip wrapper and an `aria-describedby` reason);
- its mount in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`viewMode === 'rules'`, near `:6152` at `main` `33ee9de`) only if the reason must be passed down;
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12691-*.md` for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

Outside the surface: the other Data pillar panels (Settings, Hooks, Actions), which take the same `disabled`; the read-only state itself (triage: "The read-only state itself is right"); and any new language-pack or dictionary key (the reason string exists).

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: a disabled editor gains a stated reason through an existing string. No prop, export or key changes. If the reason must reach the panel as a new prop, the prop is module-internal to app-shell (the panel is not exported); if it turns out exported, line 2 becomes `Clause-②: yes` and the body says so.
Responsibility: the Studio Data pillar's Validations editor (`@object-ui/app-shell` `ObjectValidationsPanel`) | objectui#12303 gave the Field-properties inspector the read-only-reason treatment; Publish and the Enabled toggle on the same page already carry it | every admin who opens a code package's object rules in Studio
Thread-read: 6218493223
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `33ee9de`. No open PR names `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` or `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (every open PR's file list was read: #12818, #12822, #12823, #12824, #12825, #12826, #12827). The in-flight `area:studio` cards are disjoint: this seat's objectui#12780 (`flow-node-config` and its tests) and objectui#12690 (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`), and seat-held objectui#12768 (the metadata directory page).
